feature_name: AWS Security Token Service integration for Amazon S3 transfers
summary: Storage Transfer Service introduces general availability for AWS Security Token Service (STS) integration, enabling Amazon S3 transfers using temporary credentials instead of long-term AWS credentials.
extended_definition: Storage Transfer Service introduces general availability for AWS Security Token Service (STS) integration, enabling Amazon S3 transfers using temporary credentials instead of long-term AWS credentials.
